title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1971-04-25
lineage: SBD > RM > ? > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN
source: Soundboard Partial - End of Set 2 Only

ai_review.summary: Explosive Good Lovin' jam captured in a fragment with tape problems, but the performance is off‑the‑charts.
ai_review.review: The reviewers rave about an absolutely smoking Good Lovin' that eclipses many other versions, calling it one of the best Dead jams ever.  The recording is only a fragment and suffers from noticeable tape issues, yet the energy and improvisational brilliance shine through, making it worth listening despite its technical flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: High‑energy performance with a standout jam outweighs the fair (tape‑problem) recording; limited data but consistent positive ratings.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Fragmentary copy with not‑so‑minor tape problems and occasional mistakes; overall listenable but not pristine.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Only a fragment of the show is present, leaving the rest of the set unknown.
